**Limitations**

- Each radius needs its own accumulator, so a wide range of radii is slow and needs memory.
- Ellipses and circles seen at a slant are not found.
- Concentric edges, such as both sides of a thick ring, give two circles.

**Artifacts**

- Circles of nearby radii on one round object, when the distance apart is small.
